rule: Recall quality is published as a distribution with lower-tail quantiles; a bare average is non-conformant and named-profile thresholds remain unset until first cross-adapter measurement.

checks: all returned ids belong to the fixture exact eligible set
returned count does not exceed k

perQuery.recall: canonical decimal string equal to relevantReturnedCount / exactRelevantCount

distribution.sampleCount: integer equal to the number of measured corpus queries
distribution.median: canonical decimal string; empirical quantile p=0.5
distribution.p01: canonical decimal string at sorted index floor(0.01 * (n - 1))
distribution.p05: canonical decimal string at sorted index floor(0.05 * (n - 1))
distribution.p10: canonical decimal string at sorted index floor(0.10 * (n - 1))
distribution.p25: canonical decimal string at sorted index floor(0.25 * (n - 1))

namedQualityProfiles.note: RFC §11 prohibits inventing the threshold before the first cross-adapter measurements.

forbiddenReports: mean without per-query values and lower-tail quantiles
omission of failed or empty approximate queries
